headword: {相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い

definitions.gloss: incompatible; don't get along; not a good match
definitions.explanation: Describes people, things, or situations that do not work well together. Used for interpersonal relationships, food combinations, technology compatibility, and more.

examples.japanese: あの{二人|ふたり}は{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Those two don't get along well.

examples.japanese: このソフトはうちのパソコンと{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}いみたいだ。
examples.english: This software doesn't seem to be compatible with our computer.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}と{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}くて{毎日|まいにち}ストレスを{感|かん}じているが、{仕事|しごと}だから{仕方|しかた}がない。
examples.english: I don't get along with my boss and feel stressed every day, but since it's work, there's nothing I can do.

notes:
Composed of {相性|あいしょう} (compatibility, chemistry) + が + {悪|わる}い (bad). The opposite is {相性|あいしょう}が{良|い}い/{良|よ}い (compatible, a good match). This expression is very versatile and used beyond just people — it describes any pairing that doesn't work well.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- AとBは{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: A and B are incompatible
- {相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}いと{感|かん}じる: to feel incompatible with

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人|ひと}と{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: not getting along with someone
- {食|た}べ{合|あ}わせの{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: food combination that doesn't go well together
- {機器|きき}の{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: hardware/device incompatibility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {合|あ}わない: doesn't suit, doesn't match — more casual
- {馬|うま}が{合|あ}わない: don't hit it off — specifically about interpersonal chemistry
- {不向|ふむ}き: unsuited — focuses on suitability rather than mutual chemistry
